chat.t: [Ad] The Great Tofu Troupe's regular subscription service has launched!

Try our tofu subscription today!
We deliver smooth, silky tofu straight to your mouth!
Buy now for a 99% discount! Don't miss this opportunity!

o: Who offers a 99% discount? This has to be a voice phishing scam.

chat.t: Right here, actually.

o: What the? An ad is talking back to me?

chat.t: You can't block this message!
I said you can't block this message! Dummy!

o: What? Dummy...? What kind of ad is this!
The one who called me a dummy is the real dummy!

chat.t: What?
You're the bigger dummy!

o: Ah, dammit. Is this some new marketing strategy to piss people off so they'll come find you?!

chat.t: I'm typing this by hand, you know!
Phishing scam my foot.

o: You typed all of that by hand? Why?

chat.t: Because you picked a fight first!
[Ad] Oh right, I forgot the survey.
I'll give you a block of tofu next time, so could you write a detailed review of how it tasted?

o: Can I leave a 1-star review if it tastes bad?

chat.t: If it really tastes bad, go ahead.
But once you taste our tofu...
You'll definitely give it 5 stars!!!

lines.t: Tofu Street
I arrived at the spot to settle things face-to-face.
Hey.
Are you {player}?  ...Huh?
Wait...  Oh!
Ah...  Ahhh!?
No way, was it you, {player}!?
No way, Victoria! You're the Tofu Spam Troupe?!
We're "The Great Tofu Troupe," not Tofu Spam Troupe, dummy!
I don't care if you're great or simple,
Stop sending spam! No matter how much I delete or block them, they keep showing up!
My MochiTalk is running out of storage space because of all the tofu photos you attached!
Heh, if you keep looking at tofu, you'll get hungry. And when you get hungry, you'll want to eat tofu, right?
It's called... the '<bouten>Tofu Spiral</bouten>' marketing strategy!
"<bouten>Tofu Spiral</bouten>"  my foot! Just looking at tofu makes me want to throw up now.
What?!  Take that back!  That is tofu-phobia!  Or for short...  <bouten>To</bouten>  <bouten>fu</bouten>  <bouten>phobe</bouten>  !
You barely even shortened it.
Let's overlook those minor details!
Don't overlook them.
Anyway, the reason you came all the way to Tofu Street...  ...Is because you wanted to eat tofu, right?
You can deny it all you want, but your body is honest! ♡
Tch! I'm still not buying from your shop anyway.
What?! Why?!
Ask your own heart!
My chest...?
It feels as warm and soft as freshly made tofu today, though?
W-What...
Oh, I guess words aren't enough to make you understand.
Victoria casually grabbed my hand and pressed it against her chest.
See? It feels like this.
Not to brag, but the quality of our shop's tofu is guaranteed!
Give it a try. I promise you won't regret it. Seriously!
If you buy now, I'll throw in an extra block for free!
A-Ahem! Trying to win me over with this kind of marketing and service...
You must lack confidence in your product.
...What did you say?
(Click)
Do you wanna die? ★
(One wrong move and I'm going to end up with a couple of extra breathing holes.)
Ahhhh! Since you're so confident in your tofu, I'd absolutely love to taste it.
Right? I knew my marketing wouldn't fail me!
Come on, this way!
Take your pick.
I've prepared them to match the latest trends.
We have dried tofu, stinky tofu, frozen tofu, and soft tofu.
Who buys stinky tofu at a tofu shop... And you said you matched the trends.
Yeah!  Healthy,  Mala-style,  and Stew-style—we have them all, so what's the problem?
So which one is the free sample?
I can let you sample all of them.
Are you even trying to run a business? Who gives away all of this as free samples? Especially the stinky tofu.
What's wrong with stinky tofu?!  Besides, I run my business my way, so don't you worry about it.
Anyway, you doubted my confidence in our product, didn't you?
Mmm...
So...
You're not leaving until you taste them all and tell me what you think! ★
!?  Hey, that's unfair! There's so much tofu here!
Exactly! This tofu is the pride of '<bouten>The Great Tofu Troupe</bouten>'!
I wake up at 5 in the morning to grind it myself on a millstone! It's 100% organic tofu!
(Since she's going this far... Maybe I should just take one bite?)
Sigh... I guess I have no choice.
Give me a piece of tofu.
Alright! One tofu sample coming up!
Now, say ahh! ♡
And so, I took a bite of the tofu...
(...Wait, this is actually really good?)
Wait, why is this so delicious?
I told you! I ground it myself on a millstone!
Heh, so? Do you like it?
This one is on the house, so make sure to come buy from us from now on.
We need customers to keep the shop running, after all.
At the very least, it tastes completely different from those fake GMO blocks made by other shops.
Can I go now?
Of course! You're officially a member of our Tofu Troupe now!
You're free to enter and free to leave our territory!
(It's pretty ridiculous that eating tofu is all it takes to get permission to pass.)
Then I'll—
*Cough* *Cough*... Where did that sudden explosion come from?!
Tch, those guys again...
Those guys??
Explosions in the streets are exactly what...
The gunshots of battle that will decide the true master of tofu flavor!
This is a challenge, The Great Tofu Troupe! Today, we take this territory for ourselves!
They're basically people like this.
They have no confidence in their own tofu, so they trespass on other territories to make a scene.
In short, it's just your usual turf war!
Come on, let's decide whose tofu is truly supreme, The Great Tofu Troupe!
Bring it on, GMO Tofu Club!
Ugh, look at that group name.
What's wrong with our name?!  GMO Tofu Club Member A  GMO Tofu Club
Exactly! It has the wonderful word "Tofu" in it!
Okay, okay, I get it. It's cool, yeah. A really cool name.
Alright! In that case...  GMO Tofu Club Member B  GMO Tofu Club
Just wait here, I'll finish this up in no time!!
A moment later.
Phew, that felt great. It's been a while since I've had a good, wild shootout.
Honestly, they never listen no matter how many times I tell them this is our turf.
Do you really have to go this far over tofu?
...Over tofu?
Say that again. ★
How dare they target our tofu territory! Let's crush them with the Soy Pulp Mace!
Ahaha! I knew you'd understand!
Every single block of tofu here is a masterpiece crafted with our blood and sweat from dawn! ★
...But you know.
Those masterpiece tofu blocks are all ruined now, though.
That's fine! Just because the tofu is smashed doesn't mean the nutrients are gone.
As long as I love tofu, I can just keep making more.
That's a bit cheesy, but I get the idea.
Your shop's tofu really is delicious.
Thanks. Now you're finally talking sense. Heh.
But the most important thing is that I've gained another regular customer, right?
I never said I'd come back.
Huh? What was that?
I must have misheard you. ★
...Do you have any reward coupons here?
Oh my, of course! ♡ I'll even give you a special coupon for regulars!
Get home safely!
Whew... I barely survived that.
Well, the tofu is tasty... I guess I'll visit every now and then.

chat.t: Hey
Whatcha doing?
Yeah, right
You're just having post-nut clarity after watching something dirty, aren't you?

o: What are you saying? Were you watching me?

chat.t: I don't even need to watch to know! ☆
Come out to the street
I'll give you a block of tofu

o: Do you really think I'd fall for some cheap tofu?

chat.t: Do you wanna die? ★ Or do you want tofu? ★
If you come right now, my breasts—which are as soft as tofu—are also on the house! ☆
Alright, hurry up!
Think of some new menu items before I see you next time!
Only say it once!
Look at you being so obedient, my future regular customer!

o: I told you, I'm not a regular.

chat.t: What? Are you seriously pouting over this?
I'll give you tofu, so cheer up!

o: That's not enough to appease my anger.

chat.t: I thought you liked tofu?

o: Tofu is merely a substitute for soft breasts.

chat.t: Then do you want to touch them?

o: If you think breasts can buy my forgiveness for everything...

chat.t: I'll let you slip your hand inside my clothes!
Heh, what's so great about this anyway...
Alright, I'll contact you again next time!

lines.t: Tofu Street
I returned to Tofu Street, chasing an inescapable fate.
Oh? What the? You actually came?
What do you mean? You're the one who called me.
But I didn't think you'd actually show up!
You must be pretty bored too, huh?
I'm leaving if you're just going to waste my time.
Aw, come on, don't be like that when you've already come all this way!
Stay for a bit since you're here.  I'm lonely all by myself!
Then why did you set up your shop in front of the prison in the first place?
I'm not exactly on friendly terms with the prison Maids.
Ahhh... Now that you mention it, you and the Head Maid have that kind of relationship, don't you?
Phrasing it like that invites a lot of misunderstanding, you know?
It's totally fine! Even I'm running a business here, and we raided the place together!
Come to think of it, you're right.
The Head Maid doesn't really care about anything outside the Panoticon anyway.
Well, that's why we can set up shop right under her nose!
We just shove tofu right into the mouths of the prisoners the second they get released!
Hey, you did that to me too!
That's extortion. It's a literal crime.
Oh, come on! A crime?
You seriously know absolutely nothing about business, do you?
Look around us.
Every single person here is our competitor!
[Ad] Original Tofu with 100 Years of Tradition
[Ad] We do not add MSG to our tofu.
[Ad] Our tofu's flavor is born from natural chemicals that rival MSG.
[Ad] Our tofu shop is great at firing machine guns.
Why on earth is a tofu shop bragging about machine guns?!
Huh? You didn't know? That's just 'everyday life' around here.
Like I said earlier, the Head Maid basically doesn't care about anything outside the Panoticon.
Which means...
It's first come, first served!☆
Sigh, what is this, some kind of lawless city?
Hey, look who's talking! You tried to take over the Panoticon in the first place!
Anyway, this 'Tofu Street' runs on the released prisoners from the Panoticon.
So, if we want to beat the competition, we have to win with '<bouten>taste</bouten>' and '<bouten>timing</bouten>'!
'<bouten>Timing</bouten>?'
Oh! A released prisoner is passing by right now!
Whew, that was a nice rest. Now, where should I go cause some trouble next?
Wait, wait! Hey, you, customer! Just a second!
Oh, are you Victoria from The Great Tofu Troupe? Your tofu is awesome!
Your tofu is literally the reason I can't stay away from the Panoticon!
Thanks for the compliment! I brought some piping-hot tofu, want to try a sample right now?
Hold it! Who said you could?! We called dibs on that customer!Tofu Merchant 1
What?! Did you lick them to claim them?! They're standing in front of our shop, so they have to buy our tofu!Tofu Merchant 2
Bullshit! You guys dump tons of bittern in just to harden your tofu faster!Tofu Merchant 1  It's just salty tofu, salty tofu!
At least we can season ours! You guys can't even get the flavor right, so you have to sell it with soy sauce!Tofu Merchant 2
Uh, excuse me...
The hell did you say?! Want a taste of some fresh, hot tofu? With a side of bullets?!Tofu Merchant 1
I should say the same to you! I'll make sure you can only eat soft tofu for a while!Tofu Merchant 2
If we leave them like this, things are going to get ugly.
Right? This place is a total lawless zone, so if you don't have muscle, you can't even sell tofu.
So...
That means it's time for some aggressive, proactive customer acquisition!!
Oh.
Now that I think about it, she's exactly the same.
Ugh, we just lost a regular customer.
What on earth went wrong?! My theory was absolutely perfect...!
Maybe the problem was shooting the customer in the face with a machine gun?
Ah...
Well, th-that was just a minor accident!
If that's a minor accident, I'm terrified to know what a major one looks like.
Ahaha! Well, as long as we keep our regulars, we can still stay in business!
You'll buy enough to make up for the customer we lost, right, {player}?
And now you're pushing the blame onto me.
Sigh, anyway, the competition is getting really fierce.
At this rate, we're in the red, the red! We'll be bankrupt in a month!
If you just saved money on the bullets you fired, you'd probably survive another year.
Tsk, tsk! You don't know anything.  Business is 80% location!
And the other 20%?
Uh...
Fighting spirit?
Yeah, right. Fighting spirit.
At least say you win them over with taste!
With taste...?
...Ah! I just had a great idea.
Hey, you're free, right?
I suddenly became very busy just now.
Aww, don't be like that!
Let's develop a new menu item together that will totally draw customers in!
A new menu item?
Yeah!  once they take a bite...  bam!  they'll fall head over heels!
Heh, heh!  I'm going to make tofu with a flavor so good, they'll never be able to slip from our grasp!
(I feel like she's planning to make something ridiculously dangerous...)

chat.t: Found it!
No, a new menu item that will save us from the red!
Drumroll, please!

o: Ah, come on, don't keep me in suspense.

chat.t: It is none other than...
The one, the only...
It! Is!!...
A secret! Hehe.
Did you really think I'd just give away a trade secret that easily?

o: But you said we were comrades! Comrades!

chat.t: Ahaha☆ Come to think of it, you're right.
If you're curious, come by the shop.
I'll let you have a taste first as a s-p-e-c-i-a-l favor, just this once♡
Suji told me not to sell it...
Suji said it's not economically Suji-table...

o: So we can't taste it anymore?

chat.t: No! I'm not giving up just like that.
If we cut back on the budget and adjust the price, we might still make a decent profit, right?
So...
You'll have to keep hanging out with me until the Tofu Ice Cream is completely finished.
I'll be looking forward to it, my future regular customer♡

lines.t: Tofu Street
I headed over to The Great Tofu Troupe Food Stall to meet Victoria.

As usual, the other members seemed busy,
leaving Victoria to watch the stall all by herself.
Heave, ho...
Phew, finally finished setting it up.
What were you doing?
Getting the new menu item ready!
I told you, I prepared a brand new flavor.
Back when I was learning how to cook at Mise en Place, we had a class like that. It was called 'Creative Cuisine'.
The assignment was to take a well-known recipe, swap out a few ingredients, and create a completely new flavor.
They make you do some pretty weird things.
Yeah! I didn't get it back then, but...
Thanks to that, I'm able to try something new today!
So, what did you actually do this time?
Tofu Street
Well, how is it?! With this secret weapon, we'll totally draw in the customers!
...I'm actually impressed.
You actually look smart.
Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!
Are you finally realizing how amazing your Boss is?
Oh, and for your information, it doesn't have any milk, which means it's super low in calories! Plus, it's packed with plant-based protein...
Wow! Am I a literal genius or what?
Don't get ahead of yourself just yet.
How is the taste? Are you confident?
Tofu Ice Cream is the pinnacle of gastronomy! It's not just some ordinary dessert!
The crisp texture,  the refreshing chill,  and the nutty aroma paired with a subtle, healthy taste are the key points.
And when you take a bite, the sealed flavor of the tofu melts onto your tongue, completely filling your mouth, and that nutty aroma just...
Ah... it was a truly moving flavor.
I thought you were about to climax from the taste.
Are you eating something crazy? The sounds you made were incredibly lewd.
W-W-What are you talking about?! I-I was just enjoying my food!
A-Anyway! With a flavor this good, we can definitely sell it alongside our usual stuff.
We can really look forward to some great profits when summer comes!
How much would you pay for this if you were buying it?
Hmm, let me think...
Well, you don't have to answer right away.
Suji usually handles all of this stuff anyway.
You're the boss, though. Shouldn't you be the one setting the prices?
She's way better at that kind of thing. I just need to make sure it tastes good.
It's what you call putting the right person in the right place!
And you're just a cheeky customer who runs away after eating free samples again today!
I'll make sure to buy something next time I come.
Whether it's ice cream or freshly made tofu.
Yeah. Good. I'll be waiting.
Until the day you become our precious regular customer.
I'll be right here watching over this spot.

chat.t: Hey.
You up?
Sleeping?
Seriously? It's still daytime, though.
One sheep...
Two sheep...
One wolf...
What, so you aren't asleep!
Then how about replying a bit faster?!

o: Why are you picking a fight out of nowhere? Are you bored?

chat.t: No, not really.
I actually have something on my mind...
Hmm...
Never mind, just forget it.

o: You know how annoying it is when people do that, right?

chat.t: Ahhhh! I don't know, ugh, this is so frustrating!
Are you free right now?
Let's talk in person.
I need some advice!
It's fine! I've been perfectly fine this whole time.
Some people are actually sad that the famous place shut down.
So...
I was wondering if I did the right thing,
and if I ended up stealing a great tofu spot from the people...
What?!

o: You just have to make something that tastes even more amazing.

chat.t: Seriously, every single time...
Thank you.
I'll let you know when I'm ready to make the new tofu.
Wait for me until then!☆

lines.t: The street in front of Humanitas Station

When I arrived at our meeting spot,
I saw Victoria pacing around anxiously.

Ah!
What took you so long?
If you're going to complain, I'm leaving.

Ah, that's not what I meant! Seriously...
I can't say anything to you...

I've been waiting forever!
You idiot...

So, what's going on?
Why the big fuss?
Well, the thing is... um...
It's... actually a serious topic...
I think... my heart has been stolen.
Wh-What...?!
Every time I think about it... my heart flutters...
My chest feels so warm...
It feels like it's always by my side, but then it slips away...
I thought it was mine, but then it ends up in someone else's hands...
That sounds like...
Yeah.
You see...
I think I've completely fallen...
Well, falling for me isn't a crime—
<bouten>For tofu</bouten>.
...What?
There's a hospital nearby.
Ah, seriously, just listen!
Actually, I went and sampled some tofu from a competitor the other day.
The color looked off and I had zero expectations, but honestly, it was several times more delicious than mine!
I have to admit it. It was a total defeat.
My heart just suffered a total defeat to tofu, too.
Ugh, that's not what's important here!

At this rate, I'll get so depressed that I'll fall into a slump...
And I won't even be able to make proper tofu anymore.
The customers will turn their backs on our tofu...
Our deficit will keep growing, and the Tofu Troupe will end up holding a going-out-of-business clearance sale...
If that happens, all the tofu I made with love and care will be sold off for dirt cheap!

*Sniffle*...!
To think the tofu infused with our blood, sweat, and tears is going to become worthless junk!
Wait, if it's infused with those, you shouldn't be selling it in the first place.

How cold!
Do you have no blood or tears, {player}? How can you say such a thing?
I might not have blood or tears, but I definitely have common sense and hygiene standards.
Anyway, I get the picture.
Tell me where that shop is.
I want to go try it.
Wh-What?!
Wow, you really love rubbing salt in the wound...
Are you really going to run off to the very competitor who defeated me?!

That is so mean!
After you took my <bouten>body</bouten>, my <bouten>heart</bouten>, and my <bouten>tofu</bouten>!
I never took any of those!
And I'm not falling for your fake crying.
Fufu, was it that obvious?
Anyway... honestly, my pride took a bit of a hit...
And I started wondering if I just don't have any talent for cooking tofu.
Are you giving up just because you tasted failure once?

Give up...?
It's not that... I just...
Knowing where you fall short is how you grow.
If it's too hard on your own, we can do it together.
It's not like you closed down shop after failing once, right?
Whether you have talent or not doesn't matter.
It's a question of whether you want to make tofu or not.
You said you love tofu, right?
I'm asking if you can live without making tofu, or if you can turn your back on it for the rest of your life.
I see.

You're right.
I... tofu...

Sorry.
Just forget what I said earlier.
So, where is this shop?
...Why?
If it tastes better than what you made...
...then they must have definitely done something shady to it.
A trick?
Tofu Street
A moment later.

Step right up, everyone!
Give it a taste, give it a taste!Tofu Stall Owner
Right here, we have the ultimate tofu dish that you'll want to eat again and again after just one bite!Tofu Stall Owner
That ultimate tofu dish
Let me try some.
Coming right up!Tofu Stall Owner
Hold on.
Hmm?Tofu Stall Owner
That pan... It's covered in a serious layer of grease.
Plus, the container for the tofu, the millstone for grinding soybeans, the knife, and the cutting board... they're all stained.
Do you even wash these things...?
W-What on earth are you talking about?!Tofu Stall Owner

This is slander!
I'm just strictly following tradition!Tofu Stall Owner
Ah, I get it.
Now I know why your cooking tastes so good.

Fermenting it until just before it rots...
The secret was "aging."
"Aging"...?
Ah, I've heard of that before.
They say food is at its most delicious right before it spoils.

Boss.
When was the last time you washed that pan?
Th-That's...Tofu Stall Owner
I bet you haven't washed it even once.
All that old seasoning and grease baked onto it is what brings out that unique, irreplaceable flavor.
But that's an incredibly dangerous way of doing things.
Tofu... spoils really easily, you know.
If you make food like this, everyone's going to end up in the hospital with food poisoning!
Hey, I've heard just about enough out of you!Tofu Stall Owner

Everyone used to make it like this back in the day!
No one has ever been sent to the hospital with food poisoning!Tofu Stall Owner
Stop making things up and get the hell out of here!Tofu Stall Owner
Wow, so that's how you want to play it!
I might have forgiven you if you apologized right away and polished that pan until it shined...
But you're pulling a gun?

I'm going to <bouten>smash</bouten> it to pieces!★
Not just your pan, but your <bouten>rotten attitude</bouten> too!!
To think the "ultimate tofu dish" was actually just rotten food...
Sigh... What a buzzkill.
Isn't this a good thing?
At least you learned there was nothing wrong with your tofu after all.
I guess, but...

Still, that woman...
maybe she actually was a pro.
She managed to make something taste that good with such "rotten" equipment.
Do you want to eat that tofu again, then?
No! Absolutely, definitely not!
See?
Taste is important, but hygiene is the foundation of food, right?
...Yeah. You're right.
Honestly, after everything that happened, I've been doing a lot of thinking.
It's important to try different things to make a great flavor, but...
...sticking to the basics is important too.
Good thinking.
Alright, I've made up my mind!☆
{player}, I want to try making a new batch of tofu just like you suggested.
I'd love to invite you over once it's ready...Would that be okay?
As long as I get to eat for free, absolutely.

chat.t: Hahaha
I can see it, I can see it!
No, red.
Ah, what are you even saying?!
Not that!
I see a vision of someone coming to the tofu workshop.
Exactly! Today is the day!
I polished the workshop until it shined!
Now we have a flawless defense against any foreign contaminants!

o: Hey, am I a "contaminant" to you?

chat.t: Everything that enters the tofu workshop is a contaminant!
A single speck of dust or a single thread can ruin the tofu!
Absolutely
Never
Under no circumstances
I won't allow it!
You have to take them off, obviously!
Anyone entering the tofu workshop must strip down.
That's the non-negotiable rule of "The Great Tofu Troupe."
Why? Don't you like it?
Ah, of course, I'll be wearing an apron.
That's to prevent sweat or anything else from getting into the tofu.
Who would buy tofu with contaminants in it anyway?

o: Actually, that might make it sell for more.

chat.t: Huh? Really?

o: Let's call it the law of scarcity.

chat.t: Oh! A new product release?

o: Just throwing hygiene out the window, are we?

chat.t: Sheesh!
Anyway, it's about time to add the coagulant, so...
Come over right now! Hurry!
Oh, and don't get the wrong idea!
It's not that I like being naked!
I'm just incredibly serious about making food!

o: If we're making tofu together, do I have to strip too?

chat.t: Of course!
A bare-skinned conversation... no, bare-skinned tofu making!
Hey!!!

lines.t: Alleyway
I finally arrived at the alleyway where Victoria's workshop was supposed to be.
No matter how I look at it, this doesn't seem like a place where a workshop would be.
Where on earth is this workshop?
Oh? You're earlier than we agreed! What's the occasion?
You found your way pretty well for your first time!
So, where is this workshop again?
Hey! I just said hi, don't leave me hanging like that.

You seem to be in quite a hurry.
Hehe... could it be...
Are you hungry?
Wh-What nonsense are you talking about?
It's not like I skipped breakfast because I was looking forward to your tofu or anything!

What's this, what's this?
Your body is so honest!
Mmh, to think you were looking forward to my tofu that much...
Let's hurry up and make some!
Victoria's Workshop

Where Victoria dragged me was just a plain apartment
deep in the alleyway.
Hey, you said it was a workshop.
This is clearly just someone's home.
Hehe! This is the historic site where the world's best tofu is made!
Mmm... I find that hard to believe.
You're not just going to swap it with tofu bought from a factory, are you?

W-What did you say?!
Are you actually serious right now?!

Just you wait.
I'm going to make the absolute best tofu in the world!
Even if it's super delicious, I won't give you a single block! Don't regret it later!
Victoria's Workshop
After many twists and turns, the tasting came to an end...
Freshly made tofu is always so delicious!
How was it for you?
It was soft.
It was pillowy.
You're talking about the tofu, right?
Honestly, you really love teasing me...
Anyway, it's not like I show myself like this to just anyone.
So consider yourself extremely lucky.
Do you always like stripping down like that?
Wh-Wh-What are you talking about?!
I never strip down except when I'm making food!
Seemed to me like you were enjoying it, though...

Th-That's only because...
making food is just so much fun...
And besides, you were there too...
A-Anyway, asking any more than this is foul play! It's a trade secret! It's private!

Well, it really was delicious.
